zh: 我们能不能把房租降一点？
old_en: Could we maybe reduce the rent a little?
new_en: Could we lower the rent a bit?

zh: 要不我们各让一步，房租再少一点怎么样？
old_en: Could we perhaps take a step back and reduce the rent a bit?
new_en: What if we compromise and reduce the rent a little?

zh: 我们可不可以提前下班？
old_en: Could we maybe leave work early?
new_en: Could we leave work early?

zh: 要不我们换班，你上白班，我上夜班。
old_en: What if we switch shifts, you work the day shift and I work the night shift?
new_en: What if we switch shifts, you work days and I work nights?

zh: 要不我们关门时间延后一些？
old_en: What if we extend our closing time a bit?
new_en: Could we delay the closing time a bit?

zh: 我们能不能把交货时间往后挪一挪？
old_en: Could we maybe delay the delivery date a little?
new_en: Could we push back the delivery date a little?

zh: 要不我们商量一下交货时间？
old_en: Could we maybe reschedule the delivery time to next week?
new_en: Could we discuss the delivery time?

zh: 我们能不能轮流打扫厨房？
old_en: Could we possibly take turns cleaning the kitchen?
new_en: Could we take turns cleaning the kitchen?

zh: 要不我们各自打扫自己的房间？
old_en: What if we each cleaned our own rooms?
new_en: What if we each clean our own rooms?

zh: 我们可不可以把退房时间延长到下午五点？
old_en: Could we extend the check-out time to five o'clock?
new_en: Could we extend the check-out time to five o'clock?

zh: 要不我们延迟退房到明天早上怎么样？
old_en: What if we delayed check-out until morning?
new_en: What if we delay check-out until tomorrow morning?

zh: 我们可不可以明天再约上门时间？
old_en: Could we maybe reschedule our home visit for another day?
new_en: Could we reschedule the home visit for tomorrow?

zh: 要不我们改在周末上门维修？
old_en: What if we changed the service time to the weekend?
new_en: What if we change the service time to the weekend?

zh: 要不我们商量一下，请朋友多出一些钱？
old_en: Could we split the rent into two payments?
new_en: Could we ask our friend to pay more?

zh: 退货时，我们能不能先换货？
old_en: Could we first exchange the item before returning it?
new_en: Could we exchange the item first before returning it?

zh: 退货时，要不我们先修理再退换？
old_en: Could we first repair it and then return it?
new_en: Could we fix it first before returning or exchanging?

zh: 我们能不能改改上课时间？
old_en: Could we possibly change our class time?
new_en: Could we change our class time?

zh: 要不我们上课时间换一换？
old_en: Could we switch up our class time?
new_en: Let's switch our class time, okay?

zh: 我们可不可以请朋友帮忙分担一些费用？
old_en: Could we ask our friends to help share some of the costs?
new_en: Could we ask our friends to help cover some costs?

zh: 我们能不能把租金分两期付？
old_en: Could we pay the rent in two installments?
new_en: Could we pay the rent in two payments?
